# jotmd v0.0.5

This release adds opt-in, durable Markdown memory for coding agents while keeping agent-created notes hidden from the normal JotMD view by default.

## Highlights

- Use one portable `jot-memory` skill with Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode.
- Recall relevant project and global knowledge before substantial work, with project-first search and a three-note context limit.
- Capture only durable conclusions with visible provenance, reliability, and revision-safe updates.
- Keep the reserved `agent-memory/` tree hidden by default; press `a` to toggle it or set `show_agent_memory = true`.
- Install through the included Codex and Claude Code plugin manifests, or copy the canonical skill into OpenCode's global skills directory.

`agent-memory/` is now a reserved top-level vault directory. Move existing user content out of it or explicitly adopt that content as agent-managed memory before enabling the integration. Automatic skill invocation remains best-effort.

## Installation

Upgrade JotMD with Homebrew:

```sh
brew upgrade gonfff/tap/jotmd
```
